decision_description: WP-level finish_to_start dependency edges WP1→WP2 and WP1→WP3 declared in wp_structure.json were reclassified as non-strict (informational) constraints in scheduling_constraints.json. The reclassification was required because the WP bounds derived from the Gantt schedule render finish_to_start infeasible at the WP level: WP1 ends at month 14 while WP2 starts at month 6 and WP3 starts at month 8. Task-level data_input edges (T1-03→T2-01, T1-03→T2-03, T1-03→T3-01, T1-03→T3-02, T1-03→T5-02, T2-03→T5-02, T3-02→T5-02) were preserved as non-strict data_input constraints, capturing the operative scientific dependency at the task level. All 6 milestones (MS1–MS6) passed milestone consistency checking against Gantt task completion months. No strict scheduling constraints remain unresolved.
alternatives_considered: Retain WP1→WP2 finish_to_start and delay WP2 start to month 15 (after WP1 ends month 14): rejected — this compresses WP2 to only 5 months (M15–M20), which is insufficient to complete uncertainty-aware AquaCrop calibration (T2-01), counterfactual simulation engine (T2-02), and demonstrator integration (T2-03).

Retain WP1→WP3 finish_to_start and delay WP3 start to month 15: rejected — this compresses WP3 to 9 months (M15–M24) and removes the overlap with WP1 diagnostic branch calibration (T1-03 ends M14) that enables concurrent ground-truth protocol design (T3-01 M8–M14).

Accept overlapping WP execution with data_input dependencies at task level as the operative constraint: adopted — correctly represents that downstream WPs may begin preparatory and parallel work before WP1 completes, subject to T1-03 outputs being available as data inputs at the point of scientific consumption.
tier_authority_applied: CLAUDE.md §7 Phase 4 Gate condition; Tier 4 docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase3_wp_design/wp_structure.json (dependency_map finish_to_start edges WP1→WP2 and WP1→WP3); Tier 4 docs/tier4_orchestration_state/phase_outputs/phase4_gantt_milestones/scheduling_constraints.json (normalization_log reclassification entries)
rationale: WP-level finish_to_start constraints are infeasible when WP execution windows overlap in the Gantt schedule. The scientific dependency between WP1 and WP2/WP3 is correctly captured at the task level: T1-03 (calibrate and evaluate diagnostic branch output, M10–M14) produces the posterior that downstream tasks consume as data inputs. Reclassifying the WP-level edges to non-strict preserves the dependency intent without imposing a scheduling infeasibility. The task-level data_input edges are preserved and non-strict, correctly reflecting that downstream tasks can begin preparatory work before T1-03 completes but require its outputs at their point of scientific use. The milestone consistency check (report_id: milestone_consistency_gantt_designer_2026-07-14T19:35:00+00:00) confirmed all 6 milestones are temporally consistent with their depends_on task completion months, validating the Gantt as produced.
